title: '...but look how many lives would have been saved if this was available then' Exploring the acceptability of future Human Papillomavirus self-sampling, and the barriers and facilitators of cervical cancer screening for those with intellectual disabilities in Scotland.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer screening attendance among women with intellectual disabilities (ID) in Scotland is approximately 30%, significantly below the general population rate of 69% and the WHO's recommended 70% target. HPV self-sampling could provide a more accessible screening option for this underserved population. This study aimed to understand the views and experiences of women with ID regarding cervical cancer screening and the acceptability of HPV self-sampling. METHODS: A qualitative study using focus groups was conducted with women with ID who attended third-sector community groups across Scotland, along with their carers. Four focus groups were held between September and October 2024, with a total of 13 participants (11 women with ID, 2 carers). Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. RESULTS: Five main themes emerged: (1) National Health Service (NHS) communication as a source of distress; (2) power imbalances between health care providers and women with ID: feeling unheard, dismissed and out of control; (3) enduring consequences of inadequate care; (4) past trauma shapes future avoidance; and (5) self-sampling as a pathway to empowerment. Participants demonstrated high acceptability of self-sampling, viewing it as a potential solution to overcome barriers to traditional screening. CONCLUSION: This research reveals significant systemic inadequacies in current cervical cancer screening services for women with ID, whilst highlighting self-sampling's transformative potential. Successful implementation requires comprehensive accessible information, enhanced health care professional training and trauma-informed care approaches. Self-sampling could significantly advance health equity goals whilst improving health care outcomes for this underserved population.

abstract_zh: 背景:苏格兰智障女性 (ID) 的 宫颈癌 筛查出勤率约为 30%,远低于总人口 69% 的比率和世界卫生组织建议的 70% 目标。HPV 自我采样可以为这一服务不足的人群提供更方便的筛查选择。本研究旨在了解患有 ID 的女性对 宫颈癌 筛查以及 HPV 自我采样的可接受性的看法和经验。方法:利用焦点小组对参与苏格兰第三部门社区团体的智障女性及其护理人员进行了一项定性研究。2024 年 9 月至 10 月期间举办了四次焦点小组,共有 13 名参与者(11 名患有智力障碍的女性,2 名护理人员)。使用反思性主题分析对数据进行分析。结果:出现了五个主题:(1) 国家卫生服务 (NHS) 沟通是痛苦的根源;(2) 医疗保健提供者和智障妇女之间的权力失衡:感觉被忽视、被忽视和失控;(3) 护理不足造成的持久后果;(4)过去的创伤塑造了未来的回避;(5) 自我抽样作为赋权的途径。参与者表现出对自我采样的高度接受度,将其视为克服传统筛查障碍的潜在解决方案。结论:这项研究揭示了当前 宫颈癌 针对 ID 女性的筛查服务存在显着的系统性缺陷,同时强调了自我采样的变革潜力。成功的实施需要全面的可获取信息、加强的医疗保健专业培训和创伤知情护理方法。自我采样可以显着推进健康公平目标,同时改善这一服务不足人群的医疗保健结果。

title: Cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma associated with cosmetic skin bleaching: Histological characteristics and the possible role of human papillomavirus
abstract: BACKGROUND: The occurrence and clinical characteristics of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) associated with cosmetic skin bleaching have been well documented in the literature. However, the histopathological characteristics have not yet been reported. This study aimed to describe the histological abnormalities observed in cases of cSCC associated with cosmetic skin bleaching and to explore the potential contributing factors. METHODS: We re-analysed archived paraffin-embedded tissue blocks from all cases of cSCC diagnosed in different pathology laboratories in Dakar between November 2006 and October 2021. RESULTS: We collected 19 cases of cSCC, all occurring in women, with a mean age of 58 years. On average, the women had been practising cosmetic skin bleaching for 20 years. abstract_zh: 背景:与化妆品皮肤漂白相关的皮肤鳞状细胞癌(cSCC)的发生和临床特征已在文献中有详细记载。然而,其组织病理学特征尚未见报道。本研究旨在描述在与化妆品皮肤漂白相关的鳞状细胞癌病例中观察到的组织学异常,并探讨潜在的影响因素。方法:我们重新分析了 2006 年 11 月至 2021 年 10 月期间在达喀尔不同病理实验室诊断的所有 cSCC 病例的存档石蜡包埋组织块。结果:我们收集了 19 例 cSCC 病例,全部发生于女性,平均年龄 58 岁。平均而言,这些女性从事美容皮肤漂白已有 20 年。其中大部分(14例)使用含有对苯二酚和丙酸氯倍他索混合物的漂白产品。所有癌均分化良好,其中17例(89.5%)为侵袭性。与cSCC相关的组织学异常包括所有病例中伴有淋巴浆细胞浸润的严重纤维化、18例(94.7%)毛细血管扩张、9例(47.4%)外源性黄褐斑沉积物和1例日光性弹力组织增生。此外,在 10 例(52.6%)病例中发现了挖空细胞,这是 人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染的组织学标志物。结论:与化妆品皮肤漂白相关的 cSCC 表现出独特的组织病理学模式,伴有频繁的空细胞增多 (52.6%)。这些发现支持多因素 发病机制,其中 HPV 可能充当辅助因子。未来需要使用 PCR 和原位杂交进行研究来阐明这种潜在的关联。

title: Association between HPV 16/18, HPV integration status, and CIN3 + in high-risk HPV-positive women: a multicenter cross-sectional study
abstract: This study aimed to investigate the association between human papillomavirus (HPV) 16/18, HPV integration status, and cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3 or worse (CIN3 +), and to provide evidence and theoretical support for the clinical translation of HPV integration testing. This was a multicenter cross-sectional study conducted within a cervical cancer screening program in China. HPV integration was detected using high-throughput viral integration detection (HIVID). Structural equation modeling (SEM) was employed to examine the mediating effect of HPV integration. A total of 3,077 high-risk HPV-positive women were included in the final analysis. Among these participants, 29.5% were infected with HPV 16/18, 12.9% tested positive for HPV integration, and 5.9% had biopsy-confirmed CIN3 + . Multivariable logistic regression analysis demonstrated that both HPV integration and HPV 16/18 were independently associated with CIN3 + . In mediation analysis, the standardized path coefficient for the direct effect of HPV 16/18 on CIN3 + was 0.087. For the indirect effect, the standardized path coefficient from HPV 16/18 to HPV integration was 0.404, and from HPV integration to CIN3 + was 0.771. The mediating effect of HPV integration accounted for 78.1% of the total effect. This study elucidates the mediating role of HPV integration in the progression from HPV 16/18 infection to CIN3 + , offering new insights into HPV risk stratification and clinical management.

title: Orientation of Gp96 and Calreticulin T-cell epitopes in a multiepitope HPV16 E7 vaccine construct affects predicted immunostimulatory properties: An in silico and expression validation study
abstract: Heat shock proteins (HSPs) can be used as adjuvants to develop therapeutic vaccines, as they enhance the cross-presentation of related tumor antigens and stimulate T cells. In this study, the immunostimulatory properties of gp96 and calreticulin was evaluated to enhance HPV16 E7-based vaccines effectiveness. In silico evaluation was performed to select epitopes from HSPs based on high binding affinity to MHC-I/II, strong immunogenicity, and population coverage. Six novel multiepitope constructs harboring conserved epitopes of E7, gp96, and calreticulin were designed in different orientations. Molecular docking was performed between these constructs and signaling (TLRs) and endocytic (CD14, CD91, LOX-1, and SREC-1) receptors. After determination of an effective construct in molecular docking and MD simulation, prokaryotic expression plasmid containing eight (CTL/HTL) epitopes from HPV16 E7, gp96, and calreticulin in suitable orientation was prepared, and the recombinant multiepitope peptide was generated in E. Our data showed that the gp96-CRT-E7 construct had superior docking scores with receptors (especially TLR2 and LOX-1), suggesting stronger stimulation of both innate and adaptive immunity than other constructs. It was predicted to be non-toxic, non-allergenic, antigenic, immunogenic, and structurally stable. Moreover, the multiepitope gp96-CRT-E7 fusion peptide was expressed in the Rosetta strain under conditions of OD 600 : 0.6–0.7, 0.5 mM IPTG, temperature of 18oC, and 24 hours after IPTG induction, and purified through affinity chromatography under native conditions. Generally, successful results of in silico and expression validation of the multiepitope gp96-CRT-E7 fusion peptide showed its strong potential as a novel candidate for HPV16 vaccine development.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 热休克蛋白 (HSP) 可用作佐剂来开发治疗性 疫苗,因为它们增强相关肿瘤抗原的交叉呈递并刺激 T 细胞。在这项研究中,评估了 gp96 和钙网蛋白的免疫刺激特性,以增强基于 HPV16 E7 的 疫苗 的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 以不同方向设计了六种新型多表位构建体,其中包含 E7、gp96 和钙网蛋白保守表位。在这些构建体与信号传导 (TLR) 和内吞(CD14、CD91、LOX-1 和 SREC-1)受体之间进行分子对接。通过分子对接和MD模拟确定有效构建体后,制备了含有HPV16 E7、gp96和钙网蛋白8个合适方向表位的原核表达质粒,并在大肠杆菌中产生了重组多表位肽。
elements_zh.methods: 基于对 MHC-I/II 的高结合亲和力、强免疫原性和群体覆盖度,进行计算机评估以从 HSP 中选择表位。多表位gp96-CRT-E7融合肽在特定条件下在Rosetta菌株中表达,并通过亲和层析纯化。
elements_zh.main_results: 我们的数据表明,gp96-CRT-E7 构建体与受体(特别是 TLR2 和 LOX-1)具有优异的对接分数,表明比其他构建体对先天免疫和适应性免疫具有更强的刺激作用。预计它是无毒、非过敏性、抗原性、免疫原性和结构稳定的。一般来说,多表位 gp96-CRT-E7 融合肽的计算机模拟和表达验证的成功结果表明其作为 HPV16 疫苗 开发的新候选者的强大潜力。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 多表位 HPV16 E7 疫苗 构建体中 Gp96 和钙网蛋白 T 细胞表位的方向影响预测的免疫刺激特性,其中 gp96-CRT-E7 构建体表现出卓越的免疫刺激潜力。这项研究通过计算机模拟和表达验证为 HPV16 疫苗 开发提供了一种新的候选药物。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,gp96-CRT-E7 构建体具有作为 HPV16 疫苗 开发的新候选者的强大潜力,这可以增强 疫苗 治疗 HPV 相关癌症的有效性。这种方法可能有助于改善 HPV 相关疾病的免疫治疗策略。

title_zh: 多表位 HPV16 E7 疫苗 构建体中 Gp96 和钙网蛋白 T 细胞表位的方向影响预测的免疫刺激特性:一项计算机模拟和表达验证研究
source_body_en: Heat shock proteins (HSPs) can be used as adjuvants to develop therapeutic vaccines, as they enhance the cross-presentation of related tumor antigens and stimulate T cells. In this study, the immunostimulatory properties of gp96 and calreticulin was evaluated to enhance HPV16 E7-based vaccines effectiveness. In silico evaluation was performed to select epitopes from HSPs based on high binding affinity to MHC-I/II, strong immunogenicity, and population coverage. Six novel multiepitope constructs harboring conserved epitopes of E7, gp96, and calreticulin were designed in different orientations. Molecular docking was performed between these constructs and signaling (TLRs) and endocytic (CD14, CD91, LOX-1, and SREC-1) receptors. After determination of an effective construct in molecular docking and MD simulation, prokaryotic expression plasmid containing eight (CTL/HTL) epitopes from HPV16 E7, gp96, and calreticulin in suitable orientation was prepared, and the recombinant multiepitope peptide was generated in E. Our data showed that the gp96-CRT-E7 construct had superior docking scores with receptors (especially TLR2 and LOX-1), suggesting stronger stimulation of both innate and adaptive immunity than other constructs. It was predicted to be non-toxic, non-allergenic, antigenic, immunogenic, and structurally stable. Moreover, the multiepitope gp96-CRT-E7 fusion peptide was expressed in the Rosetta strain under conditions of OD 600 : 0.6–0.7, 0.5 mM IPTG, temperature of 18oC, and 24 hours after IPTG induction, and purified through affinity chromatography under native conditions. Generally, successful results of in silico and expression validation of the multiepitope gp96-CRT-E7 fusion peptide showed its strong potential as a novel candidate for HPV16 vaccine development.
abstract_zh: 热休克蛋白 (HSP) 可用作佐剂来开发治疗性 疫苗,因为它们增强相关肿瘤抗原的交叉呈递并刺激 T 细胞。在这项研究中,评估了 gp96 和钙网蛋白的免疫刺激特性,以增强基于 HPV16 E7 的 疫苗 的有效性。基于对 MHC-I/II 的高结合亲和力、强免疫原性和群体覆盖度,进行计算机评估以从 HSP 中选择表位。以不同方向设计了六种新型多表位构建体,其中包含 E7、gp96 和钙网蛋白保守表位。在这些构建体与信号传导 (TLR) 和内吞(CD14、CD91、LOX-1 和 SREC-1)受体之间进行分子对接。经过分子对接和MD模拟确定了有效的构建体后,制备了含有HPV16 E7、gp96和钙网蛋白8个(CTL/HTL)表位的原核表达质粒,并在E中生成了重组多表位肽。我们的数据表明,gp96-CRT-E7构建体与受体(特别是TLR2和LOX-1)具有优异的对接分数,这表明比其他构建体具有更强的先天和适应性免疫刺激作用构造。预计它是无毒、非过敏性、抗原性、免疫原性和结构稳定的。此外,多表位gp96-CRT-E7融合肽在OD 600:0.6-0.7、0.5 mM IPTG、温度18°C、IPTG诱导24小时的条件下在Rosetta菌株中表达,并在天然条件下通过亲和层析纯化。一般来说,多表位 gp96-CRT-E7 融合肽的计算机模拟和表达验证的成功结果表明其作为 HPV16 疫苗 开发的新候选者的强大潜力。

source_records.title: Data from Tissue Context Shapes Distinct Premalignant Outcomes in an HPV16 E6/E7-Mutant Pik3ca Transgenic Mouse Model
source_records.abstract: Abstract High-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, particularly HPV16, is a major etiologic factor associated with multiple human cancers, including anal, cervical, and oropharyngeal carcinomas. However, the mechanisms underlying tissue-specific responses to HPV oncogene expression remain poorly understood. In this study, we developed and characterized a double-inducible transgenic mouse model enabling spatially and temporally controlled expression of HPV16 E6/E7 oncoproteins in K14-positive epithelial progenitor cells of both the anal and oral mucosae. Within 2 months of induction, HPV16 E6/E7 expression elicited epithelial hyperplasia and dysplasia in both tissues but with distinct outcomes: low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions in the anal canal and moderate to severe dysplasia in the tongue. Continuous oncogene expression was required for lesion maintenance, as doxycycline withdrawal reversed the proliferative phenotype, indicating a dynamic and reversible process. To assess whether activation of the PI3K pathway could cooperate with HPV oncogenes, we combined the E6/E7 model with a Pik3ca H1047R knock-in mouse line. Constitutive PI3K activation alone induced mild dysplasia in both epithelia, whereas its combination with E6/E7 enhanced dysplastic severity in the tongue but not in the anal mucosa. No progression to invasive carcinoma was observed within 6 months. These findings demonstrate that identical oncogenic signals—HPV16 E6/E7 expression and PI3K activation—produce distinct premalignant outcomes depending on epithelial context. This work highlights the critical role of local microenvironmental factors in HPV-driven carcinogenesis and provides a platform to identify tissue-specific therapeutic vulnerabilities in HPV-associated cancers. Significance: This work presents a double-inducible mouse model showing that HPV16 E6/E7 and PI3K activation drives distinct dysplastic outcomes in anal and oral epithelia. The study highlights how tissue context and microenvironment critically shape HPV oncogene effects, offering an important tool for uncovering mechanisms and therapeutic targets in HPV-related cancers.

source_records.abstract: Incidence of hyperplastic and dysplastic lesions in AM and tongue epithelia across all three experimental groups. Incidence was evaluated for all cases analyzed in the TG-E6/E7, K14/PI3K, and C.M. genotypes in both the anal mucosa (AM) and lingual mucosa (tongue). For statistical comparison between the two anatomic sites, cases in the AM were classified as the hyperplasia (HIPER) category including all lesions exhibiting hyperkeratosis, epithelial hyperplasia, or mild dysplasia (LSIL), whereas the dysplasia (DISP) category comprising lesions with a histopathologic diagnosis of moderate to severe dysplasia (HSIL). In the lingual mucosa, the HIPER category included lesions characterized by hyperkeratosis and epithelial hyperplasia, whereas the DISP category encompassed all dysplastic lesions, ranging from mild to severe. The normal category included histologically normal mucosa with morphology within normal limits. source_records.abstract: Morphologic changes developed in the anal and lingual mucosae of K14/PI3K animals. Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)–stained sections of the anal mucosa (AM) showing epithelial alterations at 2 and 4 months following transgene activation. A, AM from TG-E6/E7 mice displaying stratified squamous epithelium with hyperkeratosis, hypergranulosis, and areas of basal layer stratification (low magnification, 2 months). B, Region of AM exhibiting mild epithelial dysplasia. C, At 4 months, transgenic AM shows squamous epithelium with hyperkeratosis, epithelial hyperplasia, and mild dysplastic changes (low magnification). Inset, higher magnification of the area in C highlighting epithelial hyperplasia and hyperkeratosis. H&E-stained sections of tongue mucosa showing epithelial alterations at 2 and 4 months after transgene activation. D, Low-magnification view of TG-E6/E7 lingual epithelium showing marked hyperkeratosis. Bottom, a higher-magnification image reveals hyperplastic epithelium with cellular and nuclear irregularities in the basal layers and suprabasal hyperkeratosis (2 months). E, Low-magnification view of transgenic tongue epithelium showing hyperkeratosis and mild dysplasia (4 months). F, Area of a K14/PI3K transgenic tongue displaying mild dysplasia. G, Incidence of LSIL and HSIL in the AM of control mice ( N = 10) and K14/PI3K animals ( N = 7) as the percentage of the total number of animals per group. LSIL, cases diagnosed with mild dysplasia, hyperplasia, and cellular and tissue alterations involving the lower third of the epithelium; HSIL, diagnosed with moderate or severe dysplasia. Incidence of hyperplasia and dysplasia in the tongue epithelium of control mice ( N = 10) and TG-E6/E7 animals ( N = 9) as the percentage of the total number of animals per group. DISP, dysplasia; HIPER, hyperplasia(); diagnosed with mild, moderate, or severe dysplasia. *, P H, pS6 expression pattern in the anal canal of K14/PI3K mice (low magnification). Right, a higher-magnification view of the highlighted rectangular area in H shows pS6-positive cells in the suprabasal layers. I, Another area of K14/PI3K AM displaying dysplastic changes and pS6 immunoreactivity. J, Lingual epithelium from a K14/PI3K animal showing pS6 expression in the upper layers. Scale bars, 200 μm ( A , C–F , and H ); 50 μm ( B , I , J , and insets in C , D , and H ).

source_records.abstract: E6/E7 expression is sufficient to induce the development of squamous intraepithelial lesions in the anal canal of TG-E6/E7 mice. A, Panoramic view at low magnification of the genital area in a female mouse, showing the location of the murine anal canal (black dotted rectangle) in relation to the vagina (bottom left). B, Higher magnification of the area outlined in the rectangle in A , showing the normal histology of the anal canal in a control animal. C–F, Morphologic changes developed in the TG-E6/E7 anal mucosa. C, Representative histologic image of the anal mucosal epithelium from a control mouse. D–F, Representative examples of LSIL in TG-E6/E7 anal mucosa (AM). D, Anal mucosa lined by the hyperorthokeratotic squamous epithelium showing mild to moderate dysplastic changes 2 months after DOX treatment. E, AM with moderate dysplastic changes after 2 months of evolution. Note the hypergranulosis, basal stratification, and cellular and nuclear irregularities involving the lower and middle epithelial layers. F, AM with severe dysplastic changes (HSIL) after 4 months of evolution. Hyperkeratosis and cellular and nuclear irregularities involving the middle and upper epithelial layers. G, IHC expression of E6 in the anal mucosa of TG-E6/E7 mice. In G , a low-magnification image shows the patchy pattern of E6 expression along the anal canal. Black rectangles indicate areas with positive staining, shown at higher magnification to the right. Note the expression of E6 in the basal epithelial layer (top) as well as the cytoplasmic localization of E6 in individual suprabasal cells (bottom). H, Perianal skin from the E6/E7 transgenic mouse shown in G , lacking E6-positive cells. I, Control without primary antibody in TG-E6/E7 anal mucosa. J, Incidence of LSIL and HSIL in the anal mucosa of control mice ( N = 10) and TG-E6/E7 animals ( N = 17) as the percentage of the total number of animals per group. LSIL, cases diagnosed with mild dysplasia, hyperplasia, and cellular and tissue alterations involving the lower third of the epithelium; HSIL, diagnosed with moderate or severe dysplasia. TG-E6/E7: 2 months ( N = 7), 4 months ( N = 5), and 5–6 months ( N = 5). *, P K, IHC expression of K14. Low-magnification overview of TG-E6/E7 anal mucosa showing K14 expression. Right, a higher-magnification image of a hyperplastic and hyperkeratotic area shows K14 expression throughout the entire epithelial thickness. L, Immunostaining for K7. Low-magnification overview of TG-E6/E7 anal mucosa showing no K7 expression. M, Detailed view of an TG-E6/E7 anal mucosal area negative for K7. Inset, positive control for K7; glandular epithelium (intestine). N, Immunostaining for pS6 in the anal mucosa of TG-E6/E7 animals. Anal mucosa of a control animal showing minimal pS6 expression. pS6 expression in anal mucosa 2 months after E6/E7 induction, observed in the suprabasal layers; pS6 expression in anal mucosa of an animal 4 months after E6/E7 induction. Scale bars, 1 mm ( A ); 250 μm ( B ); 200 μm ( C ); 100 μm ( K and L ); 50 μm ( F–I and N ); 25 μm ( D , E , M , and insets in C and K ).

source_records.abstract: E6/E7 expression is sufficient to induce the development of squamous intraepithelial lesions in the anal canal of TG-E6/E7 mice. A, Panoramic view at low magnification of the genital area in a female mouse, showing the location of the murine anal canal (black dotted rectangle) in relation to the vagina (bottom left). B, Higher magnification of the area outlined in the rectangle in A , showing the normal histology of the anal canal in a control animal. C–F, Morphologic changes developed in the TG-E6/E7 anal mucosa. C, Representative histologic image of the anal mucosal epithelium from a control mouse. D–F, Representative examples of LSIL in TG-E6/E7 anal mucosa (AM). D, Anal mucosa lined by the hyperorthokeratotic squamous epithelium showing mild to moderate dysplastic changes 2 months after DOX treatment. E, AM with moderate dysplastic changes after 2 months of evolution. Note the hypergranulosis, basal stratification, and cellular and nuclear irregularities involving the lower and middle epithelial layers. F, AM with severe dysplastic changes (HSIL) after 4 months of evolution. Hyperkeratosis and cellular and nuclear irregularities involving the middle and upper epithelial layers. G, IHC expression of E6 in the anal mucosa of TG-E6/E7 mice. In G , a low-magnification image shows the patchy pattern of E6 expression along the anal canal. Black rectangles indicate areas with positive staining, shown at higher magnification to the right. Note the expression of E6 in the basal epithelial layer (top) as well as the cytoplasmic localization of E6 in individual suprabasal cells (bottom). H, Perianal skin from the E6/E7 transgenic mouse shown in G , lacking E6-positive cells. I, Control without primary antibody in TG-E6/E7 anal mucosa. J, Incidence of LSIL and HSIL in the anal mucosa of control mice ( N = 10) and TG-E6/E7 animals ( N = 17) as the percentage of the total number of animals per group. LSIL, cases diagnosed with mild dysplasia, hyperplasia, and cellular and tissue alterations involving the lower third of the epithelium; HSIL, diagnosed with moderate or severe dysplasia. TG-E6/E7: 2 months ( N = 7), 4 months ( N = 5), and 5–6 months ( N = 5). *, P K, IHC expression of K14. Low-magnification overview of TG-E6/E7 anal mucosa showing K14 expression. Right, a higher-magnification image of a hyperplastic and hyperkeratotic area shows K14 expression throughout the entire epithelial thickness. L, Immunostaining for K7. Low-magnification overview of TG-E6/E7 anal mucosa showing no K7 expression. M, Detailed view of an TG-E6/E7 anal mucosal area negative for K7. Inset, positive control for K7; glandular epithelium (intestine). N, Immunostaining for pS6 in the anal mucosa of TG-E6/E7 animals. Anal mucosa of a control animal showing minimal pS6 expression. pS6 expression in anal mucosa 2 months after E6/E7 induction, observed in the suprabasal layers; pS6 expression in anal mucosa of an animal 4 months after E6/E7 induction. Scale bars, 1 mm ( A ); 250 μm ( B ); 200 μm ( C ); 100 μm ( K and L ); 50 μm ( F–I and N ); 25 μm ( D , E , M , and insets in C and K ).

title_original: Data from Tissue Context Shapes Distinct Premalignant Outcomes in an HPV16 E6/E7-Mutant Pik3ca Transgenic Mouse Model

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate how tissue context shapes distinct premalignant outcomes in an HPV16 E6/E7-mutant Pik3ca transgenic mouse model, focusing on the development of squamous intraepithelial lesions in the anal canal.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a transgenic mouse model (TG-E6/E7) with HPV16 E6/E7 expression and Pik3ca mutation, comparing anal mucosa lesions in transgenic animals (N=17) to controls (N=10) at different time points (2, 4, and 5-6 months).
analysis.methods: Histopathological analysis and immunohistochemistry (IHC) were performed to assess dysplastic changes, E6 expression, and markers like K14, K7, and pS6 in the anal mucosa of transgenic and control mice.
analysis.main_results: TG-E6/E7 mice developed low-grade (LSIL) and high-grade (HSIL) squamous intraepithelial lesions in the anal mucosa, with E6 expression localized to basal and suprabasal layers, while controls showed no lesions or E6 expression.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that tissue-specific factors in the anal canal drive distinct premalignant outcomes, with E6/E7 expression sufficient to induce lesions, and the study demonstrated the model's utility for studying HPV-associated carcinogenesis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into HPV-driven carcinogenesis mechanisms and may inform surveillance and prevention strategies for HPV-associated anal lesions in humans.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the limited sample size and reliance on a single animal model, though the study provides detailed histopathological and molecular data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated how tissue context influences premalignant outcomes in an HPV16 E6/E7-mutant Pik3ca transgenic mouse model. The researchers found that E6/E7 expression alone was sufficient to induce squamous intraepithelial lesions (LSIL and HSIL) in the anal canal of transgenic mice, with E6 expression localized to basal and suprabasal layers. Histopathological analysis revealed progressive dysplastic changes, while immunohistochemistry confirmed molecular alterations. The study demonstrates the model's utility for studying HPV-associated carcinogenesis and provides insights into tissue-specific mechanisms of HPV-driven lesions, with potential implications for human HPV-related disease prevention and surveillance.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨组织背景如何在 HPV16 E6/E7 突变型 Pik3ca 转基因小鼠模型中塑造不同的癌前结局,重点关注肛管鳞状上皮内病变的发展。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用具有HPV16 E6/E7表达和Pik3ca 突变的转基因小鼠模型(TG-E6/E7),比较转基因动物(N=17)与对照(N=10)在不同时间点(2、4和5-6个月)的肛门粘膜病变。
elements_zh.methods: 进行组织病理学分析和免疫组织化学 (IHC) 以评估转基因小鼠和对照小鼠肛门粘膜中的发育异常变化、E6 表达以及 K14、K7 和 pS6 等标记物。
elements_zh.main_results: TG-E6/E7小鼠在肛门粘膜中出现低度(LSIL)和高度(HSIL)鳞状上皮内病变,E6表达局限于基底层和基底上层,而对照组则没有病变或E6表达。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,肛管中的组织特异性因素会导致不同的癌前结果,其中 E6/E7 表达足以诱发病变,并且该研究证明了该模型在研究 HPV 相关癌发生方面的实用性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了对 HPV 驱动的致癌机制的见解,并可能为 监测 和人类 HPV 相关肛门病变的预防策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管该研究提供了详细的组织病理学和分子数据,但由于样本量有限且依赖单一动物模型,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨组织背景如何在 HPV16 E6/E7 突变型 Pik3ca 转基因小鼠模型中塑造不同的癌前结局,重点关注肛管鳞状上皮内病变的发展。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用具有HPV16 E6/E7表达和Pik3ca 突变的转基因小鼠模型(TG-E6/E7),比较转基因动物(N=17)与对照(N=10)在不同时间点(2、4和5-6个月)的肛门粘膜病变。
analysis_zh.methods: 进行组织病理学分析和免疫组织化学 (IHC) 以评估转基因小鼠和对照小鼠肛门粘膜中的发育异常变化、E6 表达以及 K14、K7 和 pS6 等标记物。
analysis_zh.main_results: TG-E6/E7小鼠在肛门粘膜中出现低度(LSIL)和高度(HSIL)鳞状上皮内病变,E6表达局限于基底层和基底上层,而对照组则没有病变或E6表达。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,肛管中的组织特异性因素会导致不同的癌前结果,其中 E6/E7 表达足以诱发病变,并且该研究证明了该模型在研究 HPV 相关癌发生方面的实用性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了对 HPV 驱动的致癌机制的见解,并可能为 监测 和人类 HPV 相关肛门病变的预防策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管该研究提供了详细的组织病理学和分子数据,但由于样本量有限且依赖单一动物模型,证据强度中等。

title: NFX1-123 is required for keratinocyte differentiation and HPV 16 DNA maintenance in early and persistent infection models
abstract: ABSTRACT Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR HPV) infections cause nearly 5% of cancers worldwide, including cervical and oropharyngeal cancers. HR HPVs sustain long-term infections in stratified epithelial tissues by maintaining copies of viral genomes in basal keratinocytes and utilizing the cellular differentiation processes in the upper layers to coordinate key steps in the viral life cycle. We have demonstrated previously that the endogenous host protein NFX1-123 bound directly to the HR HPV type 16 oncoprotein E6 (16E6), and that this partnership increased keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation, two processes that are both required for persistent HPV 16 infections. As there is a range of endogenous expression of NFX1-123 in normal basal keratinocytes, we aimed to investigate the role of NFX1-123 abundance on the initiation and persistence of HPV 16 infections. In this study, we utilized keratinocytes with overexpressed, endogenous, or reduced levels of NFX1-123 and infected these cells with an HPV 16 quasivirus (Qsv) to interrogate changes to keratinocyte growth and viral DNA copy numbers with NFX1-123 modulation. Keratinocytes with reduced NFX1-123 had blunted differentiation and stratification in raft cultures, and this correlated with decreased HPV 16 Qsv DNA copies. Similarly, when we reduced NFX1-123 in W12E cells, a cervical cell line harboring episomal HPV 16 genomes, we saw a decrease in raft culture differentiation and thickness, and fewer viral genome copies compared to W12E cells with endogenous NFX1-123. These findings indicate the importance of NFX1-123 on the initiation and maintenance of HPV 16 infections that may persist and progress to cancer. IMPORTANCE A high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) infection that persists for decades is the biggest risk factor for the development of cervical and other HPV-associated cancers. The ability of HPV to maintain its genome and persist in stratified epithelium is dependent on its partnership with host proteins and its co-opting of cellular pathways. Here, we investigate how the abundance of HPV 16’s host protein partner NFX1-123 affects viral genome maintenance and replication in monolayer and three-dimensional cultures, modeling both early and persistent infection. This study reveals that NFX1-123 is required for keratinocyte differentiation and stratification in raft cultures, and the disruption of these processes significantly impedes the ability of HPV 16 to maintain its episomal genome at consistent copy numbers. These findings indicate the importance of NFX1-123 for the persistence of HPV 16 infections and encourage further investigation of NFX1-123 as a potential therapeutic target in HPV 16-positive cancers and precancers.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR HPV) infections cause nearly 5% of cancers worldwide, including cervical and oropharyngeal cancers. The study aimed to investigate the role of NFX1-123 abundance on the initiation and persistence of HPV 16 infections.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study utilized keratinocytes with overexpressed, endogenous, or reduced levels of NFX1-123 and infected these cells with an HPV 16 quasivirus (Qsv) to model both early and persistent infection.
analysis.methods: Keratinocytes with modulated NFX1-123 levels were infected with HPV 16 Qsv, and changes to keratinocyte growth and viral DNA copy numbers were analyzed in monolayer and three-dimensional raft cultures.
analysis.main_results: Keratinocytes with reduced NFX1-123 had blunted differentiation and stratification in raft cultures, correlating with decreased HPV 16 Qsv DNA copies. Similarly, reducing NFX1-123 in W12E cells decreased raft culture differentiation, thickness, and viral genome copies.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings indicate that NFX1-123 is required for keratinocyte differentiation and stratification, and its disruption significantly impairs HPV 16's ability to maintain its episomal genome at consistent copy numbers.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings highlight the importance of NFX1-123 for the persistence of HPV 16 infections and suggest it as a potential therapeutic target in HPV 16-positive cancers and precancers.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in vitro using keratinocyte models, which may not fully replicate in vivo conditions. The evidence strength is moderate due to the use of cell culture models and the need for further validation in vivo.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of the host protein NFX1-123 in HPV 16 infection persistence. Using keratinocytes with modulated NFX1-123 levels and HPV 16 quasivirus, the researchers found that reduced NFX1-123 impairs keratinocyte differentiation and stratification in raft cultures, correlating with decreased viral DNA copies. Similarly, reducing NFX1-123 in W12E cells, a cervical cell line with episomal HPV 16 genomes, led to decreased differentiation and fewer viral copies. These findings demonstrate that NFX1-123 is essential for HPV 16 genome maintenance and suggest it as a potential therapeutic target for HPV-associated cancers.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 持续的高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HR HPV) 感染导致全球近 5% 的癌症,包括宫颈癌和口咽癌。该研究旨在调查 NFX1-123 丰度对 HPV 16 感染的起始和持续性的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用 NFX1-123 过度表达、内源性或降低水平的角质形成细胞,并用 HPV 16 准病毒 (Qsv) 感染这些细胞来模拟早期和持续感染。
elements_zh.methods: 具有调节的 NFX1-123 水平的角质形成细胞被 HPV 16 Qsv 感染,并在单层和三维筏培养物中分析角质形成细胞生长和病毒 DNA 拷贝数的变化。
elements_zh.main_results: NFX1-123 减少的角质形成细胞在筏培养物中的分化和分层减弱,这与 HPV 16 Qsv DNA 拷贝数减少相关。同样,减少 W12E 细胞中的 NFX1-123 会降低筏培养物的分化、厚度和病毒 基因组 拷贝。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,NFX1-123 是角质形成细胞分化和分层所必需的,其破坏会显着损害 HPV 16 将其附加型 基因组 维持在一致拷贝数的能力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了 NFX1-123 对于 HPV 16 感染持续存在的重要性,并表明它是 HPV 16 阳性癌症和癌前病变的潜在治疗靶点。

title_zh: 在早期和持续感染模型中,NFX1-123 是角质形成细胞分化和 HPV 16 DNA 维持所必需的
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR HPV) infections cause nearly 5% of cancers worldwide, including cervical and oropharyngeal cancers. HR HPVs sustain long-term infections in stratified epithelial tissues by maintaining copies of viral genomes in basal keratinocytes and utilizing the cellular differentiation processes in the upper layers to coordinate key steps in the viral life cycle. We have demonstrated previously that the endogenous host protein NFX1-123 bound directly to the HR HPV type 16 oncoprotein E6 (16E6), and that this partnership increased keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation, two processes that are both required for persistent HPV 16 infections. As there is a range of endogenous expression of NFX1-123 in normal basal keratinocytes, we aimed to investigate the role of NFX1-123 abundance on the initiation and persistence of HPV 16 infections. In this study, we utilized keratinocytes with overexpressed, endogenous, or reduced levels of NFX1-123 and infected these cells with an HPV 16 quasivirus (Qsv) to interrogate changes to keratinocyte growth and viral DNA copy numbers with NFX1-123 modulation. Keratinocytes with reduced NFX1-123 had blunted differentiation and stratification in raft cultures, and this correlated with decreased HPV 16 Qsv DNA copies. Similarly, when we reduced NFX1-123 in W12E cells, a cervical cell line harboring episomal HPV 16 genomes, we saw a decrease in raft culture differentiation and thickness, and fewer viral genome copies compared to W12E cells with endogenous NFX1-123. These findings indicate the importance of NFX1-123 on the initiation and maintenance of HPV 16 infections that may persist and progress to cancer. IMPORTANCE A high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) infection that persists for decades is the biggest risk factor for the development of cervical and other HPV-associated cancers. The ability of HPV to maintain its genome and persist in stratified epithelium is dependent on its partnership with host proteins and its co-opting of cellular pathways. Here, we investigate how the abundance of HPV 16’s host protein partner NFX1-123 affects viral genome maintenance and replication in monolayer and three-dimensional cultures, modeling both early and persistent infection. This study reveals that NFX1-123 is required for keratinocyte differentiation and stratification in raft cultures, and the disruption of these processes significantly impedes the ability of HPV 16 to maintain its episomal genome at consistent copy numbers. These findings indicate the importance of NFX1-123 for the persistence of HPV 16 infections and encourage further investigation of NFX1-123 as a potential therapeutic target in HPV 16-positive cancers and precancers.
abstract_zh: 摘要 持续高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HR HPV) 感染导致全球近 5% 的癌症,包括宫颈癌和口咽癌。HR HPV 通过在基底角质形成细胞中维持病毒 基因组 的拷贝并利用上层的细胞分化过程来协调病毒生命周期中的关键步骤,从而维持分层上皮组织中的长期感染。我们之前已经证明,内源性 宿主 蛋白 NFX1-123 直接与 HR HPV 16 型癌蛋白 E6 (16E6) 结合,并且这种伙伴关系增加了角质形成细胞增殖和分化,这两个过程都是持续 HPV 16 感染所必需的。由于正常基底角质形成细胞中存在一系列 NFX1-123 内源性表达,我们旨在研究 NFX1-123 丰度对 HPV 16 感染的起始和持续性的作用。在这项研究中,我们利用 NFX1-123 过度表达、内源性或降低水平的角质形成细胞,并用 HPV 16 准病毒 (Qsv) 感染这些细胞,以探究 NFX1-123 调制对角质形成细胞生长和病毒 DNA 拷贝数的变化。NFX1-123 减少的角质形成细胞在筏培养物中的分化和分层减弱,这与 HPV 16 Qsv DNA 拷贝数减少相关。同样,当我们减少 W12E 细胞(一种含有附加型 HPV 16 基因组 的宫颈细胞系)中的 NFX1-123 时,我们发现与含有内源性 NFX1-123 的 W12E 细胞相比,筏培养物分化和厚度减少,病毒 基因组 拷贝数减少。这些发现表明 NFX1-123 在 HPV 16 感染的启动和维持中的重要性,这种感染可能持续并进展为癌症。重要性 持续数十年的高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染是患宫颈癌和其他 HPV 相关癌症的最大危险因素。HPV 维持其 基因组 并在复层上皮中持续存在的能力取决于其与 宿主 蛋白的伙伴关系及其对细胞途径的选择。在这里,我们研究了 HPV 16 的 宿主 蛋白伴侣 NFX1-123 的丰度如何影响单层和三维培养物中病毒 基因组 的维持和复制,模拟早期和持续感染。这项研究表明,NFX1-123 是筏培养物中角质形成细胞分化和分层所必需的,并且这些过程的破坏显着阻碍了 HPV 16 将其附加型 基因组 维持在一致拷贝数的能力。这些发现表明 NFX1-123 对于 HPV 16 感染持续存在的重要性,并鼓励进一步研究 NFX1-123 作为 HPV 16 阳性癌症和癌前病变的潜在治疗靶点。

title: Prevalence of human papillomavirus in the public health system of the central-northern region of Chile
abstract: OBJECTIVE Previously, we found a high prevalence of high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) in women attending the private health system. Therefore, the objective of this study was to determine the frequency of HR-HPV in a large cohort of women attending the public health system and to compare these findings. METHODS A total of 39,512 cervical samples from women aged 18 to 91 years who attended gynecological check-ups between 2020 and 2024 were analyzed using qPCR and the Papanicolaou technique. RESULTS The overall prevalence of HR-HPV infection between 2020 and 2024 was 13.70% (95% CI: 13.37-14.05%), with annual values of 13.07%, 12.64%, 14.80%, 14.24%, and 14.15% in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024, respectively. In women under 25 years of age, the prevalence of HR-HPV was 34.03% during the evaluated period, compared to 16.35% in women aged 25 to 44 years, 10.47% in those aged 45 to 64 years, and 11.52% in women over 64 years of age. Pap smears showed 89.71% NILM results in HPV-negative women, compared to 74.59% in HPV-positive women. The rates of LSIL and HSIL were 0.14% and 0.07% in HPV-negative women, respectively; however, these values increased to 4.73% and 4.43% in HPV-positive women, respectively. Probable carcinoma was found in only 0.006% of HPV-negative women, but in 0.46% of HPV-positive women. CONCLUSIONS The prevalence of HR-HPV infection in women attending the public health system in the central-northern region appears to be similar to that previously reported in Chile, but lower than that reported in the same region for women attending the private health system.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to determine the frequency of high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) in women attending the public health system, as previous research had found a high prevalence in the private health system.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study analyzed 39,512 cervical samples from women aged 18 to 91 years who attended gynecological check-ups between 2020 and 2024 in the central-northern region of Chile.
analysis.methods: Samples were analyzed using qPCR and the Papanicolaou technique to detect HR-HPV infection and cytological abnormalities.
analysis.main_results: The overall prevalence of HR-HPV infection was 13.70% (95% CI: 13.37-14.05%), with higher rates in women under 25 years (34.03%) compared to older age groups. HPV-positive women had significantly higher rates of LSIL (4.73% vs. 0.14%) and HSIL (4.43% vs. 0.07%) than HPV-negative women.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that HR-HPV prevalence in the public health system was similar to previously reported national rates but lower than in the private health system in the same region, highlighting potential disparities in HPV infection rates between healthcare systems.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Findings inform public health surveillance and resource allocation by providing age-stratified prevalence data, which can guide targeted screening and prevention strategies for HPV-related diseases in the public health system.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's strength lies in its large sample size and longitudinal design, but limitations include potential selection bias as only women attending gynecological check-ups were included, and the evidence is moderate due to the abstract-only nature of the report.

analysis.summary_en: This study determined the prevalence of high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) in 39,512 women attending Chile's public health system between 2020-2024. The overall HR-HPV prevalence was 13.70%, with significantly higher rates in women under 25 years (34.03%) compared to older age groups. HPV-positive women had markedly increased rates of cytological abnormalities, including LSIL (4.73% vs. 0.14%) and HSIL (4.43% vs. 0.07%) compared to HPV-negative women. The prevalence was similar to national rates but lower than previously reported in the private health system, suggesting potential healthcare disparities. These findings provide valuable data for public health planning and targeted screening programs.

title_zh: 智利中北部地区公共卫生系统中的患病率 人乳头瘤病毒
source_body_en: OBJECTIVE Previously, we found a high prevalence of high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) in women attending the private health system. Therefore, the objective of this study was to determine the frequency of HR-HPV in a large cohort of women attending the public health system and to compare these findings. METHODS A total of 39,512 cervical samples from women aged 18 to 91 years who attended gynecological check-ups between 2020 and 2024 were analyzed using qPCR and the Papanicolaou technique. RESULTS The overall prevalence of HR-HPV infection between 2020 and 2024 was 13.70% (95% CI: 13.37-14.05%), with annual values of 13.07%, 12.64%, 14.80%, 14.24%, and 14.15% in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024, respectively. In women under 25 years of age, the prevalence of HR-HPV was 34.03% during the evaluated period, compared to 16.35% in women aged 25 to 44 years, 10.47% in those aged 45 to 64 years, and 11.52% in women over 64 years of age. Pap smears showed 89.71% NILM results in HPV-negative women, compared to 74.59% in HPV-positive women. The rates of LSIL and HSIL were 0.14% and 0.07% in HPV-negative women, respectively; however, these values increased to 4.73% and 4.43% in HPV-positive women, respectively. Probable carcinoma was found in only 0.006% of HPV-negative women, but in 0.46% of HPV-positive women. CONCLUSIONS The prevalence of HR-HPV infection in women attending the public health system in the central-northern region appears to be similar to that previously reported in Chile, but lower than that reported in the same region for women attending the private health system.

title: Efficacy of live lactobacillus preparations in treating cervical inflammation and clearing viral infections in patients with HPV infection complicated by bacterial vaginosis
abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Dingjunsheng, a live Lactobacillus preparation, as adjuvant therapy in patients with human papillomavirus (HPV) infection complicated by bacterial vaginosis (BV). A retrospective analysis was conducted on 152 eligible patients, randomly divided into two groups: the observation group (n=87) receiving standard BV antibacterial therapy plus Dingjunsheng, and the control group (n=65) who received standard BV antibacterial therapy alone. The patients were followed up for six months. Primary outcomes included HPV clearance rate and cervical cytological inflammation improvement, while secondary outcomes involved BV recurrence rate and adverse reaction incidence. The results showed that the observation group had a significantly higher HPV clearance rate (73.6% vs 53.9%) and inflammation improvement rate (90.8% vs 76.9%), as well as a lower BV recurrence rate (3.1% vs 13.9%) compared to the control group. Dingjunsheng was identified as an independent protective factor for HPV clearance (OR=2.5, 95%CI:1.3–5.1). The incidence of adverse reactions was similar between both groups. We conclude that Dingjunsheng adjuvant therapy demonstrated effectiveness in improving HPV clearance, alleviating inflammation, and reducing BV recurrence, with good safety, making it a valuable treatment strategy for these patients.

title: High-Risk Cervical Human Papillomavirus Prevalence in a Northeast Nigeria Community: A Descriptive Study.
abstract: Background: Disparities in cervical screening result in disproportionate cervical cancer burdens in populations. This study assessed cervical human papillomavirus (HPV) infection prevalence in a rural northeast Nigeria community with low access to cervical screening. Methodology: A community health outreach was conducted at a primary healthcare facility in Azare, Bauchi State, Nigeria. The women who wished to and consented to undergo gynaecological consultations were non-randomly enrolled on the study and provided their sociodemographic data and cervical specimens (Pap smear and cytobrush exfoliates in viral transport media) for the study. These were analysed cytologically and for the presence of HPV deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA). Results: Of 62 women screened (mean age 38.5 ± 9.8 years), 34 (54.8%) tested positive for HPV DNA (95% confidence interval = 43-67%). Among these positive cases, 19 had no intraepithelial lesion or malignancy (NILM), 8 were designated atypical squamous cell of undetermined significance (ASCUS), and 6 showed low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (LSIL). In contrast, one case was high-grade SIL (HSIL). Thirty single infections were seen, HPV 16 being the commonest (18 cases), followed by HPV 18 (9 cases), while non-16, non-18 genotypes (genotypes 31, 33, 35, 39, 45, 51, 52, 56, 58, 59, 66, 67, 68), collectively termed "Others", accounted for 3 cases. Coinfections among different genotype classes (genotypes 16, 18 and Others) occurred in 4 additional cases. Most of the women had a primary education or higher (43; 69.4%), were married (53; 85.5%), and were multiparous (52; 83.9%). However, the majority had not heard about cervical cancer (35; 56.5%), while 60 (96.8%) women had never been screened previously. Conclusions: The results suggest a high prevalence of cervical HR-HPV and SIL in Azare. Improved public enlightenment and access to cervical cancer screening services may help to decrease transmission of HPV and subsequent cervical cancer in the population.

abstract_zh: 背景:宫颈癌筛查的不平等导致人群中的宫颈癌负担不均衡。本研究评估了尼日利亚东北部一个农村社区(该地区宫颈癌筛查服务可及性低)的人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染患病率。方法:在尼日利亚包奇州Azare的一家基层医疗设施开展社区健康外展活动。愿意并同意接受妇科咨询的女性被非随机纳入研究,并提供其社会人口学数据和宫颈标本(巴氏涂片和细胞刷脱落物置于病毒运输培养基中)用于研究。这些标本通过细胞学分析检测HPV脱氧核糖核酸(DNA)的存在情况。结果:在62名接受筛查的女性中(平均年龄38.5±9.8岁),34人(54.8%)HPV DNA检测呈阳性(95%置信区间=43-67%)。在这些阳性病例中,19人无上皮内病变或恶性病变(NILM),8人被诊断为意义不明的非典型鳞状细胞(ASCUS),6人显示低级别鳞状上皮内病变(LSIL)。相比之下,1例为高级别SIL(HSIL)。观察到30例单一感染,其中HPV 16最常见(18例),其次是HPV 18(9例),而非16、非18型别(型别31、33、35、39、45、51、52、56、58、59、66、67、68)统称为"其他"型别,占3例。不同型别类别(16、18和其他型别)之间发生共感染的有4例。大多数女性具有小学或更高学历(43人;69.4%),已婚(53人;85.5%),且为经产妇(52人;83.9%)。然而,大多数女性从未听说过宫颈癌(35人;56.5%),而60人(96.8%)从未接受过筛查。结论:结果表明,Azare地区宫颈高危型HPV和鳞状上皮内病变的患病率较高。加强公众健康教育并提高宫颈癌筛查服务的可及性,可能有助于降低人群的HPV感染率和随后的宫颈癌发病率。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 宫颈筛查的差异导致人群的 宫颈癌 负担不成比例。本研究评估了尼日利亚东北部农村社区宫颈 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染 患病率 的情况,宫颈筛查的普及率较低。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在尼日利亚包奇州阿扎雷的一家初级医疗机构开展了社区健康外展活动。希望并同意接受妇科咨询的女性是非随机登记的,并提供了她们的社会人口统计数据和宫颈标本。
analysis_zh.methods: 对这些样本进行细胞学分析并分析是否存在 HPV 脱氧核糖核酸 (DNA)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 62 名接受筛查的女性中(平均年龄 38.5 ± 9.8 岁),34 名 (54.8%) HPV DNA 检测呈阳性(95% 置信区间 = 43-67%)。在这些阳性病例中,19例没有上皮内病变或恶性肿瘤(NILM),8例被指定为意义未明的非典型鳞状细胞(ASCUS),6例显示低度鳞状上皮内病变(LSIL)。相比之下,1 例为高级别 SIL (HSIL)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,Azare 中宫颈 HR-HPV 和 SIL 的 患病率 较高。提高公众意识和获得 宫颈癌 筛查服务可能有助于减少人群中 HPV 的 传播 和随后的 宫颈癌。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,迫切需要在尼日利亚阿扎雷等服务欠缺的社区加强 传播 筛查和公共卫生教育,以减少 HPV 传播 和相关的 宫颈癌 风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到非随机入组和小样本的限制,这可能会影响普遍性。由于描述性且缺乏对照组,证据强度中等。

title: HPV vaccination intention and its association with vaccine hesitancy and health beliefs among unvaccinated Chinese medical college students: A cross-sectional study
abstract: BACKGROUND: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection poses a significant public health challenge, and HPV vaccination uptake among Chinese college students remains suboptimal. Therefore, it is essential to conduct ongoing, in-depth investigations into the psychological and cognitive mechanisms of HPV vaccination intention. This study aims to explore the associations among HPV vaccination intention, vaccine hesitancy, and health beliefs among Chinese medical college students. METHODS: A cross-sectional survey was conducted from June 16 to July 16, 2024, to assess sociodemographic characteristics, vaccine hesitancy, and health belief model (HBM) among college students at Guangdong Medical University. Descriptive statistics, univariate analysis, and binary logistic regression were performed to identify factors associated with HPV vaccination intentions among unvaccinated students. RESULTS: Among 3,584 unvaccinated participants, 73.16% expressed willingness to receive the HPV vaccine. The key significant associations identified included gender (male) (OR: 0.26; 95% CI: 0.22 ~ 0.31; p < 0.001), parental occupation (employees in enterprises, commercial, and service industries (including self-employed)) (OR: 1.43; 95% CI: 1.18 ~ 1.75; p < 0.001), and information sources (hospitals or doctors) (OR: 1.37; 95% CI: 1.15 ~ 1.64; p = 0.001). Vaccination intention was also directly associated with the perceived necessity (OR: 0.91; 95% CI: 0.88 ~ 0.94; p < 0.001) and importance (OR: 1.07; 95% CI: 1.03 ~ 1.10; p < 0.001) of vaccine hesitancy, as well as the perceived benefits of behavior for the HBM (OR: 1.21; 95% CI: 1.12 ~ 1.32; p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: In this sample, Chinese medical college students demonstrated a relatively high willingness to receive HPV vaccination. Willingness was positively associated with perceived necessity, importance, and benefits of vaccination. Integrating structured clinician-delivered counseling into curricula, using parental occupation data for targeted subsidies, and embedding classroom sessions comparing personal HPV risk with vaccine safety data may improve uptake. Government evaluation of gender-neutral vaccination policies and provision of male-inclusive campus services are also recommended.

title: Implementation and impact of primary HPV testing in cervical cancer screening: Historical perspectives and institutional experience at a large academic medical center
abstract: Abstract Recognition of high‐risk human papillomavirus (HPV) as the etiologic agent in nearly all cervical cancers has fundamentally reshaped screening strategies, driving the development and adoption of highly sensitive molecular HPV assays. Over the past several decades, cervical cancer screening guidelines have shifted from primarily cytology‐based approaches toward HPV‐based modalities, with primary HPV testing now recommended as the preferred method by the American Cancer Society and anticipated to be similarly endorsed by the United States Preventive Services Task Force. This article traces the evolution of cervical cancer screening, from the original Papanicolaou test to current guideline recommendations, and discusses the logistical requirements for transitioning to a primary HPV screening system, including triage strategies for HPV‐positive cases. The authors additionally present an institutional experience of initiating primary HPV testing, highlighting its impact on cytopathology laboratory workflow and specimen volumes.

source_records.abstract: Recognition of high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) as the etiologic agent in nearly all cervical cancers has fundamentally reshaped screening strategies, driving the development and adoption of highly sensitive molecular HPV assays. Over the past several decades, cervical cancer screening guidelines have shifted from primarily cytology-based approaches toward HPV-based modalities, with primary HPV testing now recommended as the preferred method by the American Cancer Society and anticipated to be similarly endorsed by the United States Preventive Services Task Force. This article traces the evolution of cervical cancer screening, from the original Papanicolaou test to current guideline recommendations, and discusses the logistical requirements for transitioning to a primary HPV screening system, including triage strategies for HPV-positive cases. The authors additionally present an institutional experience of initiating primary HPV testing, highlighting its impact on cytopathology laboratory workflow and specimen volumes.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on human papillomavirus (HPV) as the etiologic agent in cervical cancer, examining the evolution of screening strategies from cytology-based approaches to primary HPV testing, with emphasis on logistical requirements and triage strategies for HPV-positive cases.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a historical and institutional experience article, not a systematic review or meta-analysis. It traces the evolution of cervical cancer screening guidelines and presents an institutional case study of implementing primary HPV testing.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Primary HPV testing is now the preferred screening method recommended by the American Cancer Society and anticipated to be endorsed by the United States Preventive Services Task Force, due to its high sensitivity in detecting high-risk HPV.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not explicitly discuss controversies or evidence gaps, focusing instead on the transition to primary HPV testing and its institutional impact.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The implications include the need for logistical adjustments in cytopathology laboratories to accommodate increased specimen volumes and the development of triage strategies for HPV-positive cases.

The authors present institutional experience, noting the impact on laboratory workflow and specimen volumes. The review emphasizes the endorsement of primary HPV testing by major guidelines and anticipates further adoption, though it does not address controversies or evidence gaps.

abstract_zh: 摘要:认识到高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 是几乎所有 宫颈癌 的病原体,从根本上重塑了筛查策略,推动了高灵敏度分子 HPV 检测的开发和采用。在过去的几十年里,宫颈癌 筛查指南已从主要基于细胞学的方法转向基于 HPV 的方法,初级 HPV 检测现已被美国癌症协会推荐为首选方法,并预计将得到美国预防服务工作组的类似认可。本文追溯了 宫颈癌 筛查的 进化,从最初的巴氏测试到当前的指南建议,并讨论了过渡到初级 HPV 筛查系统的后勤要求,包括 HPV 阳性病例的分诊策略。作者还介绍了启动初级 HPV 检测的机构经验,强调了其对细胞病理学实验室工作流程和样本量的影响。

title: The oral microbiota in oral squamous cell carcinoma: unravelling mechanisms and clinical potential
abstract: Originating in the mucosal lining of the mouth, oral squamous cell carcinoma is the most common malignancy of the head and neck regions. Its pathogenesis is multifactorial, involving environmental exposures, genetic susceptibility, and lifestyle-related risk factors. Increasing evidence indicates that oral microbial dysbiosis contributes to the initiation and progression of OSCC. Under healthy conditions, the oral cavity harbors a diverse and functionally balanced microbial ecosystem that maintains mucosal integrity, supports immune homeostasis, and prevents colonization by pathogenic species. Disruption of this equilibrium, known as oral dysbiosis, is increasingly recognized as a key event in oral carcinogenesis. In OSCC, a shift toward pathogenic and pro-inflammatory microbial communities has been consistently observed, particularly involving periodontal bacteria such as Porphyromonas gingivalis, Treponema denticola, and Fusobacterium nucleatum. These organisms contribute to tumor progression by activating inflammatory and oncogenic signaling pathways, including NF-κB, STAT3, and PI3K/Akt; suppressing apoptosis; inducing epithelial–mesenchymal transition; and immune evasion, thereby creating a tumor-promoting microenvironment. In addition to bacterial dysbiosis, viral and fungal components of the oral microbiome may act as important cofactors in OSCC. High-risk Epstein–Barr virus (EBV) and human papillomavirus (HPV) have been implicated in disrupting tumor suppressor pathways, causing genomic instability, and modulating the immune response. Fungal species, particularly Candida albicans, may further contribute by producing carcinogenic metabolites and inducing chronic inflammation. This review provides an integrated overview of the oral microbiome in OSCC, focusing on the composition and protective roles of the core microbiota, factors influencing microbial stability, and mechanisms by which dysbiosis contributes to carcinogenesis. It also highlights the oral microbiome as a potential source of non-invasive biomarkers and discusses microbiome-targeted strategies, including prebiotics, probiotics, and postbiotics, as promising adjunctive approaches to restore microbial balance and reduce tumor-promoting inflammation.

This review provides an integrated overview of the oral microbiome in OSCC, focusing on the composition and protective roles of the core microbiota, factors influencing microbial stability, and mechanisms by which dysbiosis contributes to carcinogenesis. It also highlights the oral microbiome as a potential source of non-invasive biomarkers and discusses microbiome-targeted strategies, including prebiotics, probiotics, and postbiotics, as promising adjunctive approaches to restore microbial balance and reduce tumor-promoting inflammation.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注口腔鳞状细胞癌 (OSCC) 中的口腔微生物群,探讨其在致癌机制和临床潜力中的作用。核心问题涉及了解微生物失调如何导致口腔鳞癌的发生和进展。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述对 OSCC 中的口腔微生物组进行了综合概述,重点关注其组成、保护作用、稳定性因素和致癌机制。它还讨论了作为潜在辅助方法的微生物组靶向策略。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 人们一致认为口腔微生物失调会导致口腔鳞癌的发生和进展。牙龈卟啉单胞菌和齿垢密螺旋体等致病菌可激活致癌途径,而 高危型HPV 和白色念珠菌则充当辅助因子。口腔微生物组被认为是非侵入性生物标志物的来源。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述没有明确提及争议或证据差距,但强调需要进一步研究微生物组靶向策略以及不同微生物成分促进致癌的具体机制。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述建议以微生物组为目标的策略,包括益生元、益生菌和后生元,作为恢复微生物平衡和减少促肿瘤炎症的有前途的辅助方法。它还强调了口腔微生物组作为非侵入性生物标志物来源的潜力。

abstract_zh: 口腔鳞状细胞癌起源于口腔粘膜,是头颈部最常见的恶性肿瘤。其发病机制是多因素的,涉及环境暴露、遗传易感性和生活方式相关的危险因素。越来越多的证据表明口腔微生物失调有助于口腔鳞癌的发生和进展。在健康条件下,口腔拥有多样化且功能平衡的微生物生态系统,可维持粘膜完整性,支持免疫稳态,并防止病原菌定植。这种平衡的破坏被称为口腔生态失调,越来越多地被认为是口腔癌发生的关键事件。在口腔鳞癌中,一直观察到向致病性和促炎性微生物群落的转变,特别是涉及牙周细菌,如牙龈卟啉单胞菌、齿垢密螺旋体和具核梭杆菌。这些生物体通过激活炎症和致癌信号通路(包括 NF-κB、STAT3 和 PI3K/Akt)来促进肿瘤进展;抑制细胞凋亡;诱导上皮-间质转化;和免疫逃避,从而创造一个促进肿瘤的微环境。除了细菌失调外,口腔微生物组的病毒和真菌成分可能是口腔鳞癌的重要辅助因子。高风险 Epstein-Barr 病毒 (EBV) 和 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 与破坏肿瘤抑制途径、导致基因组不稳定和调节 免疫应答 有关。真菌物种,特别是白色念珠菌,可能进一步产生致癌代谢物并诱发慢性炎症。本综述对口腔鳞癌的口腔微生物群进行了综合概述,重点关注核心微生物群的组成和保护作用、影响微生物稳定性的因素以及生态失调导致癌变的机制。它还强调口腔微生物组作为非侵入性生物标志物的潜在来源,并讨论了针对微生物组的策略,包括益生元、益生菌和后生元,作为恢复微生物平衡和减少促肿瘤炎症的有前途的辅助方法。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注口腔鳞状细胞癌 (OSCC) 中的口腔微生物群,探讨其在致癌机制和临床潜力中的作用。核心问题涉及了解微生物失调如何导致口腔鳞癌的发生和进展。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述对 OSCC 中的口腔微生物组进行了综合概述,重点关注其组成、保护作用、稳定性因素和致癌机制。它还讨论了作为潜在辅助方法的微生物组靶向策略。

analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述没有明确提及争议或证据差距,但强调需要进一步研究微生物组靶向策略以及不同微生物成分促进致癌的具体机制。

title: Insights of Vietnamese American Women on Cervical Cancer Screening and HPV Self-Sampling
abstract: Abstract Vietnamese American women experience one of the highest cervical cancer incidence and mortality rates in the United States, largely due to low screening uptake. To inform strategies for reducing this burden, we explored the experiences and attitudes toward cervical cancer screening, including the perceptions on Human papillomavirus (HPV) self-sampling, among Vietnamese American women. Between April 2023 and July 2024, we conducted four focus groups and three individual interviews with 21 Vietnamese American women aged 30–65 residing in Southern California. Participants were stratified by nativity and age: Vietnam-born ages 30–49, Vietnam-born ages 50–65, and U.S.-born ages 30–49. All focus groups and interviews were conducted online and moderated by a bilingual researcher using semi-structured guides. Participants also watched videos on screening methods and shared their views. The discussions were recorded, transcribed, and thematically analyzed using Dedoose 10.0.59. Three themes emerged, with no differences across strata. First, structural and psychosocial barriers to physician-based screening were identified. Second, HPV self-sampling was viewed as a potential solution to these barriers, though there were mixed opinions regarding one’s ability to self-sample correctly, potential discomfort, and logistics related to obtaining a device and mailing samples. Third, other opportunities to improve screening uptake were identified, including a high willingness to undergo screening, the potential to capitalize on the strong trust in physicians, and the opportunities to leverage community-based resources. Our findings suggest that a multifaceted approach integrating HPV self-sampling and provider and community engagement has the potential to improve cervical cancer screening uptake among Vietnamese American women.
journal: Journal of Racial and Ethnic Health Disparities

title: Opportunities and Barriers to HPV Vaccination Among Men Who Have Sex with Men and Related Sexual and Gender Minority Populations: A Systematic Review and Exploratory Clustering Analysis Using a Socio-Ecological Framework
abstract: Background: Men who have sex with men (MSM) experience a disproportionate burden of human papillomavirus (HPV)-related disease, yet vaccination uptake remains uneven. With MSM as the key population of interest, this review synthesized evidence on uptake, willingness, multilevel barriers and opportunities, and vaccine-oriented outcomes among MSM and related sexual and gender minority populations when MSM-relevant findings could be extracted. Methods: Six databases were searched for original English- or Chinese-language studies published from 1 January 2010 to 31 December 2025. Findings were synthesized narratively. Barriers and opportunities were mapped using a five-level socio-ecological model; study-level willingness–uptake patterns were explored using K-means clustering as an exploratory analysis among the nine studies reporting both outcomes; and genotype-specific and immunogenicity findings were summarized separately. Results: Fifty-three studies involving 169,241 participants were included; 87.2% of participants were MSM, and 79% of studies were cross-sectional. Barriers and opportunities occurred across individual, provider-related interpersonal, organizational/institutional, community, and policy/societal levels. Recurrent paired mechanisms involved knowledge and trust, provider recommendation and communication, service accessibility, community support, and eligibility and affordability. Nine studies contributed data to the exploratory clustering analysis; seven fell into low-uptake clusters, including three with high willingness but low uptake, which may indicate a possible study-level implementation gap. Two studies reporting genotype prevalence and antibody responses provided limited biological context supporting vaccination before exposure and suggesting potential benefit from catch-up vaccination. Discussion: Among MSM and related sexual and gender minority populations, HPV vaccination is shaped by interacting individual and structural conditions, with MSM remaining the principal focus of the evidence base. Improving uptake is likely to require complementary strategies: universal, gender-neutral routine vaccination in adolescence before their sexual debut, and targeted catch-up for MSM who missed routine vaccination, supported by trusted provider endorsement, convenient service delivery, community engagement, and inclusive, affordable policy. The thematic counts were study-level and unweighted, and the nine-study clustering analysis was exploratory rather than definitive.

With MSM as the key population of interest, this review synthesized evidence on uptake, willingness, multilevel barriers and opportunities, and vaccine-oriented outcomes among MSM and related sexual and gender minority populations when MSM-relevant findings could be extracted. Methods: Six databases were searched for original English- or Chinese-language studies published from 1 January 2010 to 31 December 2025. Findings were synthesized narratively. Barriers and opportunities were mapped using a five-level socio-ecological model; study-level willingness–uptake patterns were explored using K-means clustering as an exploratory analysis among the nine studies reporting both outcomes; and genotype-specific and immunogenicity findings were summarized separately. Results: Fifty-three studies involving 169,241 participants were included; 87.2% of participants were MSM, and 79% of studies were cross-sectional. Barriers and opportunities occurred across individual, provider-related interpersonal, organizational/institutional, community, and policy/societal levels. Recurrent paired mechanisms involved knowledge and trust, provider recommendation and communication, service accessibility, community support, and eligibility and affordability. Nine studies contributed data to the exploratory clustering analysis; seven fell into low-uptake clusters, including three with high willingness but low uptake, which may indicate a possible study-level implementation gap. Two studies reporting genotype prevalence and antibody responses provided limited biological context supporting vaccination before exposure and suggesting potential benefit from catch-up vaccination. Discussion: Among MSM and related sexual and gender minority populations, HPV vaccination is shaped by interacting individual and structural conditions, with MSM remaining the principal focus of the evidence base. Improving uptake is likely to require complementary strategies: universal, gender-neutral routine vaccination in adolescence before their sexual debut, and targeted catch-up for MSM who missed routine vaccination, supported by trusted provider endorsement, convenient service delivery, community engagement, and inclusive, affordable policy. The thematic counts were study-level and unweighted, and the nine-study clustering analysis was exploratory rather than definitive.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review synthesized evidence on HPV vaccination uptake, willingness, barriers, and opportunities among MSM and related sexual and gender minority populations. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 男男性行为者 (MSM) 承受着不成比例的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 相关疾病负担,但 疫苗接种 的吸收仍然不均匀。本综述综合了 MSM 和相关性少数群体中的接受、意愿、多层次障碍和机会以及以 疫苗 为导向的结果的证据。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项系统综述纳入了53项研究,涉及169,241名参与者,其中87.2%为男男性行为者(MSM),79%的研究为横断面研究。该综述重点关注MSM及相关性少数群体,前提是可以提取到与MSM相关的研究结果。
elements_zh.methods: 检索了六个数据库,查找 2010 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 12 月 31 日发表的原始英文或中文研究。使用五级社会生态模型绘制了障碍和机遇,并使用 K 均值聚类在报告这两种结果的九项研究中探索了研究级别的意愿-接受模式。
elements_zh.main_results: 纳入了53项涉及169,241名参与者的研究;87.2%的参与者为男男性行为者,79%的研究为横断面研究。重复配对的机制涉及知识和信任、提供者推荐和沟通、服务可及性、社区支持,以及资格和可负担性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在 MSM 和相关性少数群体中,HPV 疫苗接种 是由个体和结构条件相互作用形成的,其中 MSM 仍然是证据基础的主要焦点。九项研究为探索性聚类分析提供了数据;七个属于低采用率集群,其中三个意愿较高但采用率较低,这可能表明研究层面的实施差距可能存在。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 提高采用率可能需要补充策略:在青春期首次性行为之前进行通用的、性别中立的常规 疫苗接种,并针对错过常规 疫苗接种 的 MSM 进行有针对性的追赶,并得到值得信赖的提供商认可、便捷的服务交付、社区参与以及包容性、负担得起的政策的支持。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 主题计数是研究级别的且未加权,九项研究的聚类分析是探索性的而不是确定性的。由于采用了系统评价方法,证据强度中等,但受到聚类和未加权主题计数的探索性性质的限制。

Barriers and opportunities were mapped using a five-level socio-ecological model; study-level willingness–uptake patterns were explored using K-means clustering as an exploratory analysis among the nine studies reporting both outcomes; and genotype-specific and immunogenicity findings were summarized separately. Results: Fifty-three studies involving 169,241 participants were included; 87.2% of participants were MSM, and 79% of studies were cross-sectional. Barriers and opportunities occurred across individual, provider-related interpersonal, organizational/institutional, community, and policy/societal levels. Recurrent paired mechanisms involved knowledge and trust, provider recommendation and communication, service accessibility, community support, and eligibility and affordability. Nine studies contributed data to the exploratory clustering analysis; seven fell into low-uptake clusters, including three with high willingness but low uptake, which may indicate a possible study-level implementation gap. Two studies reporting genotype prevalence and antibody responses provided limited biological context supporting vaccination before exposure and suggesting potential benefit from catch-up vaccination. Discussion: Among MSM and related sexual and gender minority populations, HPV vaccination is shaped by interacting individual and structural conditions, with MSM remaining the principal focus of the evidence base. Improving uptake is likely to require complementary strategies: universal, gender-neutral routine vaccination in adolescence before their sexual debut, and targeted catch-up for MSM who missed routine vaccination, supported by trusted provider endorsement, convenient service delivery, community engagement, and inclusive, affordable policy. The thematic counts were study-level and unweighted, and the nine-study clustering analysis was exploratory rather than definitive.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项系统综述纳入了53项研究,涉及169,241名参与者,其中87.2%为男男性行为者(MSM),79%的研究为横断面研究。该综述重点关注MSM及相关性少数群体,前提是可以提取到与MSM相关的研究结果。
analysis_zh.methods: 检索了六个数据库,查找 2010 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 12 月 31 日发表的原始英文或中文研究。使用五级社会生态模型绘制了障碍和机遇,并使用 K 均值聚类在报告这两种结果的九项研究中探索了研究级别的意愿-接受模式。
analysis_zh.main_results: 纳入了53项涉及169,241名参与者的研究;87.2%的参与者为男男性行为者,79%的研究为横断面研究。重复配对的机制涉及知识和信任、提供者推荐和沟通、服务可及性、社区支持,以及资格和可负担性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在 MSM 和相关性少数群体中,HPV 疫苗接种 是由个体和结构条件相互作用形成的,其中 MSM 仍然是证据基础的主要焦点。九项研究为探索性聚类分析提供了数据;七个属于低采用率集群,其中三个意愿较高但采用率较低,这可能表明研究层面的实施差距可能存在。

title: Allele-specific chromatin modifications of HPV-associated extrachromosomal DNAs in cervical cancer
abstract: Abstract Cervical cancer, a human papillomavirus (HPV) driven malignancy, is the fourth deadliest cancer in females. Approximately 25% of primary cervical cancers contain circular structures called extrachromosomal DNAs (ecDNAs), which can be entirely composed of human DNA (human-only ecDNAs) or a combination of HPV and human DNA sequences (HPV-human hybrid ecDNAs). Human-only ecDNAs harbour cancer-driving oncogenes, but epigenetic differences between human-only and HPV-human hybrid ecDNAs are unexplored. Here we report that 30% of cervical cancers contained at least one ecDNA. HPV-human hybrid ecDNAs contained more active enhancers and promoters than human-only ecDNAs and invariably contained the HPV oncogenes E6 and E7 . These ecDNAs also contained an allelic hypomethylation region associated with putative human promoters, as well as enrichments for motifs associated with recombination hotspots. By leveraging long-read WGS phasing data to separate ChIP-seq data into alleles, we revealed allele-specific peaks in enhancers and promoters on ecDNAs, of which HPV-human hybrid ecDNAs contained a higher density. Overall, we found HPV-human hybrid and human-only ecDNAs differed in their regulation, often at an allele-specific level. Our study more firmly establishes the importance of epigenome disruption in cervical cancer and how structural variation, particularly surrounding HPV integration sites, may shape the surrounding regulatory architecture.

title_zh: 宫颈癌 中 HPV 相关染色体外 DNA 的等位基因特异性染色质修饰
source_body_en: Abstract Cervical cancer, a human papillomavirus (HPV) driven malignancy, is the fourth deadliest cancer in females. Approximately 25% of primary cervical cancers contain circular structures called extrachromosomal DNAs (ecDNAs), which can be entirely composed of human DNA (human-only ecDNAs) or a combination of HPV and human DNA sequences (HPV-human hybrid ecDNAs). Human-only ecDNAs harbour cancer-driving oncogenes, but epigenetic differences between human-only and HPV-human hybrid ecDNAs are unexplored. Here we report that 30% of cervical cancers contained at least one ecDNA. HPV-human hybrid ecDNAs contained more active enhancers and promoters than human-only ecDNAs and invariably contained the HPV oncogenes E6 and E7 . These ecDNAs also contained an allelic hypomethylation region associated with putative human promoters, as well as enrichments for motifs associated with recombination hotspots. By leveraging long-read WGS phasing data to separate ChIP-seq data into alleles, we revealed allele-specific peaks in enhancers and promoters on ecDNAs, of which HPV-human hybrid ecDNAs contained a higher density. Overall, we found HPV-human hybrid and human-only ecDNAs differed in their regulation, often at an allele-specific level. Our study more firmly establishes the importance of epigenome disruption in cervical cancer and how structural variation, particularly surrounding HPV integration sites, may shape the surrounding regulatory architecture.

title: HPV Vaccination Knowledge, Perceptions and Beliefs Among School Health and Nutrition Supervisors in Bahawalpur District, Pakistan: A Cross- Sectional Study
abstract: Abstract Cervical cancer, predominantly caused by Human Papillomavirus (HPV), remains the fourth most common cancer in women globally, with over 90% of deaths occurring in low- and middle-income countries. School Health and Nutrition Supervisors (SHNS) are the frontline school health cadre whose advocacy quality directly influences HPV vaccination uptake, and their knowledge and the adequacy of health system training targeting them is largely unexamined. This cross-sectional census survey used a validated structured self-administered questionnaire to assess HPV vaccination knowledge, perceptions and beliefs among all 58 actively deployed SHNS across 21 Union Councils of Bahawalpur District, South Punjab, Pakistan (September 2025 to April 2026). Respondents were predominantly male (69.0%), above 40 years of age (79.3%) and held postgraduate qualifications (98.3%). While 96.6% correctly identified the vaccination target age group and 82.8% recognised pre-debut vaccine efficacy, 55.2% harboured the systemic misconception that HPV vaccination provides 100% protection against cervical cancer — a belief most plausibly attributable to flawed or incomplete training content rather than individual inattentiveness, given that 82.8% receive training updates at least annually. Only 37.9% knew the correct two-dose schedule and 41.4% recognised the continuing necessity of post-vaccination cervical cancer screening. All 58 supervisors (100%) had recommended HPV vaccination in the previous 12 months. Education, gender, school type and geographic location were significant predictors of knowledge. These findings demonstrate that a motivated, well-educated workforce is being systematically under-informed by inadequate training content, with direct implications for the quality and clinical accuracy of vaccine promotion delivered to parents and students. Urgent reform of HPV training content, school-level communication protocols and locally adapted Urdu-language materials is required.

title_zh: 巴基斯坦巴哈瓦尔布尔地区学校健康和营养主管的 HPV 疫苗接种 知识、认知和信念:横断面研究
source_body_en: Abstract Cervical cancer, predominantly caused by Human Papillomavirus (HPV), remains the fourth most common cancer in women globally, with over 90% of deaths occurring in low- and middle-income countries. School Health and Nutrition Supervisors (SHNS) are the frontline school health cadre whose advocacy quality directly influences HPV vaccination uptake, and their knowledge and the adequacy of health system training targeting them is largely unexamined. This cross-sectional census survey used a validated structured self-administered questionnaire to assess HPV vaccination knowledge, perceptions and beliefs among all 58 actively deployed SHNS across 21 Union Councils of Bahawalpur District, South Punjab, Pakistan (September 2025 to April 2026). Respondents were predominantly male (69.0%), above 40 years of age (79.3%) and held postgraduate qualifications (98.3%). While 96.6% correctly identified the vaccination target age group and 82.8% recognised pre-debut vaccine efficacy, 55.2% harboured the systemic misconception that HPV vaccination provides 100% protection against cervical cancer — a belief most plausibly attributable to flawed or incomplete training content rather than individual inattentiveness, given that 82.8% receive training updates at least annually. Only 37.9% knew the correct two-dose schedule and 41.4% recognised the continuing necessity of post-vaccination cervical cancer screening. All 58 supervisors (100%) had recommended HPV vaccination in the previous 12 months. Education, gender, school type and geographic location were significant predictors of knowledge. These findings demonstrate that a motivated, well-educated workforce is being systematically under-informed by inadequate training content, with direct implications for the quality and clinical accuracy of vaccine promotion delivered to parents and students. Urgent reform of HPV training content, school-level communication protocols and locally adapted Urdu-language materials is required.
